waiting.title: Late or waiting right now

waiting.none: Nothing is past due or waiting today.

delaysReport.note: Days late are counted two ways. Finished: for every task finished in this period, the date it finished (India time) minus its due date, when that is positive. Open: for every open task already past its due date, today minus its due date, whatever the period. The cause is the party the step waits on (set by its template, or by whoever marked it waiting); DISCOM time is utility time and is shown apart from internal time. The chart shows finished tasks only, in the week or month they finished. A DISCOM step's days run from the day it was started (or its planned start) to the day it finished.
